title: Rav Tuvi son of Rav Nechemyah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Beitzah 12b: he had a jug of terumah wine and came before Rav Yosef, asking, “May I bring it to a Kohen today?” etc. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Tuvi son of Rav Mattenah, which Hyman prefers because, in his observation, Rav Tuvi son of Rav Nechemyah is not mentioned anywhere else.
